title_sq: Ne Kompleksin "Colonnade", Prane Zogut Te Zi, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Hapsira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Ne Kompleksin "Colonnade", Prane Zogut Te Zi, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, me siperfaqe neto 99.2 m/2 dhe siperfaqe bruto 120.1 m2. Ndodhet ne katin e 5-te banim te nje super projekti ne ndertim. Organizohet me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen e ambientit te ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe ballkonin, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e femijeve dhe tualeti dites. title_en: In the "Colonnade" complex, near the Black Bird, 2+1+2 apartment for sale with ample spaces!!
description_en: In the "Colonnade" Complex, near Zogut Te Black, 2+1+2 Apartment for sale, with a net area of ​​99.2 m/2 and a gross area of ​​120.1 m2. It is located on the 5th residential floor of a super project under construction. It is organized with the corridor that distributes the living room with ample surface area together with the kitchen corner and the balcony, matrimonial bedroom with its own toilet, children's room and day toilet.
